attestations.text: WANG Fu-ch'ên 王輔臣, d. Oct. 10, 1681, general, was a native of Tatung, Shansi. It is reported that he came from a family named Li 李 of Honan, and that at the close of the Ming period he attached himself to a band of outlaws.
